integrity: The proof derives exact round colors from clipped cyclic distances to the unique center, separates within-petal refinement from cross-length collisions, and identifies the final orbit classes. A standalone checker recomputes both statements on 2,992 parameter tuples.
scientific limitations: Only ordinary one-dimensional color refinement from the uniform coloring on simple rose graphs is treated.
The finite checker covers two through five petals with lengths 3 through 12; the infinite theorem rests on the clipped-distance proof.
The orbit-recovery statement may follow from broader refinable-graph characterizations; the originality claim is centered on the exact depth formula.
No independent literature audit has been performed.
title: Exact color-refinement depth of rose graphs
